cert_source.description: Path to CA cert/key file or directory containing certificates.

ssl_port.description: Port to listen on for SSL interception.

firefox_update_location.description: Location of any Firefox XML update files.

http_port.description: Port to listen on for HTTP interception. Set to 0 to disable.

intercept_browsers.description: Comma-separated list of browsers to intercept (ff,ie,safari,opera).

ocsp_deny.description: Deny OCSP requests for our certificates.

intercept_addon_update.description: URL to intercept Mozilla Addon Updates.

addon_sha256.description: The sha256sum value of the addon to inject.
